title: Bobo's Rainbow

coreLoop: advance to next round and restart after game over
fairness: hearts must be reachable within the playfield
spawn and fall speed must allow a reasonable reaction window
round speed increase must not make success practically impossible

reviewFocus: Check that the bear, kitten, hearts, and rainbow read clearly at portrait mobile size.
Check whether collecting hearts visibly repairs the rainbow and communicates progress toward helping the kitten.
Evaluate whether missed hearts, combos, levels, and faster rounds create a fair learning curve.
Check touch targets, contrast, HUD overlap, and whether the restart affordance is actually usable.
